title: The planning competition of 2011 as CNF, examples
why: The planning competitions distribute PDDL, not formulas, so every SAT author who wants to work on planning rebuilds the same translation and the same encoding. This pack is those instances as CNF, at several plan lengths, produced by one pinned chain: Fast Downward's translator, then the freeLunch encoder. The plan length is what the published SAT competition instances fix to one or two values, and what a solver author needs to vary.

items.domains: strips only: the encoder does not take the ADL domains
items.note: classical strips domains only: the chain translates classical planning, so the temporal, numeric, metric and preference variants of a competition are left out rather than tried and refused

permission: to ask: the instances are collected and republished by the Potassco group from the planning competitions; the CNF is derived from them by a pinned chain
size_note: measured on a sample: a gripper instance at ten steps is 23 thousand clauses, a depots one 399 thousand, and a hundred-block task 61 million. A full pack needs the instances chosen with their size in mind.
example_note: a pack is a handful of small formulas, meant to be looked at, not a benchmark suite: the sizes a solver author needs are produced on demand with the same pinned chain, by changing the plan length or picking another task
regenerate: tools/fetch_upstream.py ipc && docker run --rm -v "$CACHE/ipc/files/ipc-2011/domains/<domain>:/data:ro" satex-gen/freelunch:2022 domain.pddl instances/<instance>.pddl cr <plan length>

built.chain: Fast Downward translator, then freeLunch compactReinforced

coverage_note: 55 formulas. Of the tasks tried, 46 are past the clause limit, which is our choice, sixteen failed in the encoder, and 27 were the same formula twice or three times. A domain of the planning competition is published once per track, and the tracks differ in how a planner is scored, not in the PDDL: the same domain and the same instance give the same SAS+ task and the same formula. Those are dropped, the kept file recording the other names it answers to.
